tests.name: test_endian_macros_existence
tests.intent: Verify that JSON_LITTLE_ENDIAN_TARGET and JSON_BIG_ENDIAN_TARGET macros are defined and expand to valid integer literals.

tests.name: test_endian_mutually_exclusive
tests.intent: Verify that JSON_LITTLE_ENDIAN_TARGET and JSON_BIG_ENDIAN_TARGET are mutually exclusive or both zero.

tests.name: test_preprocessing_conditional
tests.intent: Verify that JSON_LITTLE_ENDIAN_TARGET can be evaluated in preprocessing conditional blocks (#if).

tests.name: test_preprocessing_big_conditional
tests.intent: Verify that JSON_BIG_ENDIAN_TARGET can be evaluated in preprocessing conditional blocks (#if).

tests.name: test_json_type_traits_compilation
tests.intent: Verify that type traits header inclusion via json.hpp works correctly and exposes basic types.

tests.name: test_json_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify basic JSON object creation and dump output.

tests.name: test_json_integer_values
tests.intent: Verify JSON handles standard integer bounds correctly.

tests.name: test_json_float_precision
tests.intent: Verify JSON float values format with fixed precision output.

tests.name: test_json_parse_error
tests.intent: Verify parse error handling and exception message formatting.

tests.name: test_json_pointer_access
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer operations work correctly alongside standard headers.

tests.name: test_ordered_json_insertion
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json maintains insertion order deterministically.

tests.name: test_json_array_push_back
tests.intent: Verify basic array push_back operations and dumping.

tests.name: test_json_contains_key
tests.intent: Verify object contains method behavior.

tests.name: test_json_merge_patch
tests.intent: Verify RFC 7396 merge patch functionality.

tests.name: test_json_sax_interface
tests.intent: Verify basic SAX parser interface callback behavior.

tests.name: test_json_type_query
tests.intent: Verify type query methods (is_object, is_array, etc.) on standard json types.

tests.name: test_json_initializer_list
tests.intent: Verify complex nested initializers compile and dump correctly.

tests.name: test_json_patch_operations
tests.intent: Verify JSON Patch (RFC 6902) execution.

tests.name: test_json_binary_types
tests.intent: Verify binary JSON data structures if supported by current version.

tests.name: test_json_iterator_traversal
tests.intent: Verify standard iterator traversal over a JSON object.
